official.deadline_central_display: Study application 15 January; scholarship round opens in February
official.deadline_note: Lund University publishes no exact calendar date for the ARUA scholarship round - it states the round usually opens in early February each year and that applicants cannot apply until they receive the email with the link to the scholarship application portal in February. The gating study-application deadlines are 15 January for the application and early February for the application fee and supporting documents.
official.application_cycle: Annual round for the following autumn intake - 15 January study application, February scholarship portal opening
official.status_note: The ARUA Scholarship application round usually opens in early February each year and the link is published on the global scholarship page once applications open. Applicants who have completed a Lund first-choice application are notified by email when the period opens.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The ARUA Scholarship covers a percentage of the tuition fees, up to a maximum of 90%. The exact percentage awarded depends on the available budget of the programme or faculty concerned.
benefits: Tuition fee waiver of a percentage of tuition fees, up to a maximum of 90%
Selection runs in parallel with the programme selection process
eligibility: Be or have been a student at an ARUA university in one of the countries listed on the Lund ARUA page
Be a citizen of a country from outside the EU/EEA (and Switzerland) and be required to pay tuition fees for studies at Lund University
Have submitted a correct, complete and timely application for an international degree programme at Lund University
Have selected Lund University as first choice in the application at universityadmissions.se
requirements: A correct, complete and timely application for an international degree programme at Lund University
Lund University selected as first choice at universityadmissions.se
A personal scholarship motivation video of maximum 1 minute uploaded to an open-source video sharing platform such as YouTube or Vimeo
The video link included in the scholarship application form
Financial need must not be presented in the video, since the scholarship is merit-based only
documents: Completed scholarship application submitted through the Lund University scholarship application portal
Link to a personal scholarship motivation video of maximum 1 minute hosted on an open-source platform
Application fee and supporting documents for the Lund degree application, due in early February
selection_criteria: Judged to be a good fit for the programme applied for
Strong commitment and desire to study at Lund University
Selected a programme at Lund University as first choice at universityadmissions.se
Financial situation and challenges are not considered, as the scholarship is merit-based only
coverage: A percentage of tuition fees, up to a maximum of 90%, set by the available budget of the programme or faculty
application_method: Apply for an international degree programme at Lund University with Lund as first choice at universityadmissions.se
Pay the application fee and submit supporting documents in early February
Watch for the emailed link to the Lund University scholarship application portal, which opens in February
Upload the maximum 1-minute motivation video to an open-source platform and paste the link into the application form
official.application_route: Lund first-choice degree application at universityadmissions.se, then the separate Lund scholarship portal once the February email invitation arrives.
official.citizenship_residency: Citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who are required to pay tuition fees, and who are or have been students at a listed ARUA member university
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the award is designed for African students who have studied at a listed ARUA member university and who must pay non-EU/EEA tuition fees.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Enrolment at, or previous study at, one of the ARUA member universities listed by country on the Lund page (for example Addis Ababa University, University of Ghana, University of Ibadan, Makerere University, University of Cape Town). Lund notes the list may not reflect the latest ARUA changes.
official.duration: Follows the degree programme the applicant is awarded for; the page does not publish a fixed award duration
official.description: Lund University describes the ARUA Scholarship Programme as providing financial support to prospective students who have demonstrated academic excellence at one of the member universities of ARUA, as a selective and merit-based scholarship for African students committed to Lund University.
official.program_type: University tuition-fee scholarship, merit-based and restricted to ARUA member-university students
official.english_requirement: Applicants must apply to an international degree programme at Lund University; English proficiency requirements are set by the programme and by universityadmissions.se.

not_confirmed: exact percentage of tuition awarded to any individual applicant
verification.notes: The ARUA page on lunduniversity.lu.se was read in full. Lund publishes only a maximum of 90% of tuition fees with the actual percentage set by programme or faculty budget, and explicitly states living costs are not covered. Page last updated 6 October 2026.

applicant_utility.summary: The percentage you actually receive is not decided centrally - it is whatever budget your programme or faculty has left, so two equally strong candidates in different faculties can receive very different waivers up to the 90% ceiling. The application sequence is unforgiving: a complete Lund application with Lund ranked first, then a separate portal that only opens in February and only after you get the email link. The one-minute video is the whole pitch, and because the scheme is explicitly merit-based, spending your seconds on hardship will actively waste them.
applicant_utility.best_fit: A high-achieving graduate of a listed ARUA member university who is fee-liable at Lund and can explain, in sixty seconds, why Lund specifically fits their field.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your previous or current institution is on the ARUA list for your country, and cross-check against arua.org since Lund warns its list may lag changes
Rank Lund first at universityadmissions.se before the 15 January application deadline
Submit the application fee and supporting documents in early February
Storyboard the 1-minute video around academic achievement and fit with the programme, not on financial need
Host the video on an open platform and verify the link is public and unlisted-proof before pasting it into the form
common_rejection_risks: Ranking another university first at universityadmissions.se, which the page states makes the application ineligible
Applying to the ARUA scholarship without a complete, timely Lund application
Opening the video with financial hardship, which the selection process explicitly disregards
Waiting for a public announcement instead of the emailed portal link, and missing the early February window
Assuming the ARUA decision arrives separately - it is bundled into the same email as the Global Scholarship result, so a missed email reads as a rejection
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs in full, plus the remaining slice of tuition if the waiver is set below 90%. Lund points recipients to the Swedish Migration Agency's living-expense requirement, which must still be evidenced even for scholarship holders.
document_audit: The video is the discriminator here: one minute maximum, on an open-source platform, with the link typed into the form - a broken or private link is an incomplete application
Supporting documents for the degree application are due in early February, a separate deadline from the 15 January application close
Only one ARUA scholarship may be held per application round, so consolidating the plan into a single round is the practical route
alerts: There is no public calendar date for the February scholarship round - if the invitation email does not arrive, chase it rather than waiting
The award can be stacked with the Lund University Global Scholarship and Swedish Institute scholarships, so do not treat them as mutually exclusive
A scholarship offer must be accepted within the time frame stated in the award letter, and the study place must be accepted separately at Lund
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Lund first-choice application at universityadmissions.se by 15 January with fee and documents in early February, February portal opening by email, video link submission, parallel programme and scholarship selection, combined result email after admission results.
